description: Split a text on real boundaries (paragraph, else sentence, never mid-word) with the overlap you ask for, and optionally rank the chunks against a query with BM25. Use it to prepare a RAG corpus, or to see why a query fails to retrieve what it should. No model involved: this is the lexical half, the one that finds literal terms — a code, a surname, a version number — that an embedding dissolves.

overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks; capped at half the size

query.description: If given, chunks come back ranked by BM25 against it

size.description: Target size of each chunk, in characters

name: rag_prepare
title: Chunk a text and rank the chunks against a query
